title: Kanmani Anbudan
episodeTitle: Anbu Takes Up a Sacred Ritual
description: Kanmani lights a lamp at the temple cursed for pregnant women, alarming villagers. Anbu seeks a way to protect their unborn child by carrying water for a sacred anointing ritual.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Rishi uncovers Kalamma's scheme framing Viji's son, but she tricks him into blaming Paraman and Ilamathi. Kalamma alerts Rishi, so he rushes to save Ayyapan from Paraman.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Swetha and Sivashankari rally behind Divya after learning that her uncle is forcing her to marry him. Elsewhere, Abinaya fumes at Vetri after receiving a custody notice for Sudar.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Mayandi lauds Azhagar and Poongodi for their Best Couple win after they return home. Meenatchi firmly warns Poongodi not to help with household chores despite her good intentions.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Suresh tells Thangaraj about Malar's demand for apologies. Later, Malar ignores Bagyaraj's worry for Lakshmi and fights over past neglect, enraging Bagyaraj.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Saravanan confronts Thangamayil, but she remains firm about not returning home. Later, he finds her collapsed on the road, struggling with pain, and rushes her to hospital.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan brings Nila breakfast, breaking her fast. While others eat out, Cheran is shocked when Chandayatha takes the full family budget money from him.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Meena and Muthu plan a new business. Inspired by a dream and Vijaya mentioning Gulkand, Meena finds her idea, but gets dizzy when an excited Muthu spins her.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: As the village issue escalates, the advocate advises Sethupathi and Nesan to abscond, but they refuse to prove their innocence. Later, the police arrest them for investigation.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Kasthuri is heartbroken after discovering Karthik's diary filled with memories of his love for Priya. Meanwhile, Shyam warns Arjun to stay away from Madhu as he cannot dismiss him.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Kandhasamy permits Shanmugam to attend college at Murugan's request. Indhira proposes 30 millet dosa varieties to give the mess menu a tasty makeover and attract customers.
